ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Qualify"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Qualify")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), /* Simplified check - full implementation would use a rollup or related list query via Flow/Apex */ FALSE )
